guard: `$JS.API.STREAM.INFO.TASK` is granted by the `role` gate and by nothing else: a role-carrying agent reads task stream state, a role-less one does not, and neither reads DM, DLV or EPC.
proveWith: pnpm mutation-proof --config packages/core/smoke/mutations/provision-stream-info-role-gate.json   # --config resolves against the repo root, never the cwd
why: The agent profile emits a JetStream consumer-create DENY triple on DM, TASK and DLV, and for a
while it emitted no matching `$JS.API.STREAM.INFO` row for any of them. The first repair granted
STREAM.INFO on all four of DM, TASK, DLV and EPC, unconditionally, to every agent. That is wider
than the deny triple's shape suggests, because `subjects_filter` is a REQUEST-BODY field: no ACL
can split `STREAM.INFO` into 'message counts' and 'enumerate every retained subject'. A role-less
agent holding it on DM reads the whole DM social graph (who DMed whom, per-pair volume) and the
task-routing graph, on streams it has no other grant on at all.
The narrowed grammar: `STREAM.INFO.TASK` moved inside the existing `if (svcD)` role gate, next to
the `svc_<role>` bind rows it belongs with, and the DM/DLV/EPC rows removed outright (an agent
reaches DM and DLV through a pre-created durable by name and EPC through a subject-scoped
DIRECT.GET, so no agent-side caller reads any of them at stream level).
These mutations re-broaden the grant one stream at a time, so each deny cell is shown to measure
its OWN row rather than riding on a neighbour's. Re-broadening is the honest mutation here: it is
the exact code state the cells were reconciled against, so a cell that stays green under it is a
cell that would have blessed the wider grant.
This config grades the gate from both sides. Removing the gated row must redden the positive
cell, and re-broadening past the gate must redden the role-less deny cell; a suite that only
checked the role-carrying agent would call an ungated grant correct, which is the bug.

mutations.name: the role gate stops granting STREAM.INFO on TASK at all
mutations.expectRed: STREAM.INFO TASK succeeds for the role-carrying agent
mutations.cell: STREAM.INFO TASK succeeds for the role-carrying agent
mutations.note: The positive direction. Without this the suite would be all deny cells, which an empty grant list also satisfies.

mutations.name: STREAM.INFO on TASK escapes the role gate
mutations.expectRed: STREAM.INFO TASK is denied to the role-less agent (the role gate is what grants it)
mutations.cell: STREAM.INFO TASK is denied to the role-less agent (the role gate is what grants it)
mutations.note: Same mutation as the G2 cell in the sibling config, graded here against a live role-less credential provisioned alongside the role-carrying one, so the gate is measured as a difference between two agents rather than as one agent's refusal.

mutations.name: STREAM.INFO on the DM stream is granted to every agent again
mutations.expectRed: STREAM.INFO DM is denied to the role-carrying agent (no subject enumeration)
mutations.cell: STREAM.INFO DM is denied to the role-carrying agent (no subject enumeration)
mutations.note: Carrying a role must not buy DM stream state either: the gate widens TASK and only TASK.
